title: Device smoke of the REAL core on Waydroid (PATH-B Chaquopy)

device.runtime: Waydroid container, ABI x86_64, Android API 33 (lineage-based)
device.install: waydroid app install (native CLI; AMENDMENT-1 - adb bridge unavailable)

result: PASS - the REAL Python/Flask/SQLite core runs on device: real templates render, and the core's own server-side validators and a real DB write were exercised end-to-end.

evidence_files.shows: REAL dashboard (nav: Dashboard/Portfolio/Watchlist/Financial Goals/Alerts/Settings; Total Invested/Received/Next Payout; Invested vs Received per company panel; filters All/Danger/On-going/Matured) - parity with the web UI

Portfolio -> My Holdings: page title 'Portfolio', tabs My Holdings / Payouts, 'Position registry' table (Company/ISIN, Rating, Qty, Coupon, Yield, Frequency, Invested, Received, Next Payout, Status), the empty-state row 'No positions yet...' and the Status legend (Watching/On-going/Danger/Matured); the real route + template render on device, empty state

Watchlist -> Add Candidate (the add-position form): Company, ISIN, Rating, Rating agency, Coupon %, Est. Yield %, Issuer type, Secured, Face value, Payout cycle, Invested, Quantity, Per-bond price, Source note, Broker, + Add Candidate
REAL core validation #1 - submitted form rejected by the Python backend: 'Error: ERR-watch-add / coupon is required' (server-side validator, not client JS)
REAL core validation #2 - 'Error: ERR-watch-add / est yield is required'
REAL core validation #3 - 'ISIN format invalid: INE000A01001E (expected 12 characters, e.g. INE900A01001)'

REAL core WRITE success - 'success: Candidate added: Acme Bonds Ltd'; the candidate row appears in the Watchlist table (Rating AA, Coupon 8.5%, Est. Yield 9.0%) with Move to Portfolio / Delete actions. Proves the on-device SQLite write path.
Move to Portfolio form (Purchase date, Start date, End date, Credit day, Invested amount, Quantity, Per-bond price, Broker) + Move/Cancel
waydroid app install transcript (sha256, size, rc=0, package listed)
host-side waydroid log (container freeze/unfreeze + install activity)

revisions.fresh_recapture: NOT done as a new on-device capture: by the time of the fix the GNOME desktop session was LOCKED (clock screen), so injecting input risked typing into the lock password field; the genuine P3 capture of the same route (taken on this device at 04:07 during P3) was promoted instead. A further fresh capture can be taken once the session is unlocked if required.

limitations: waydroid logcat/shell require root - on-device logcat is NOT available (same constraint Stage 1 recorded); host-side waydroid log captured instead.

Synthetic input used (ydotool -> /dev/uinput, absolute coords). Absolute positioning drifts on the Waydroid WebView because the viewport re-scrolls when inputs take focus. Consequence: the final 'Move to Portfolio' submit (which would populate the Portfolio holdings table) was NOT completed through the UI in this run; the holdings table itself renders (see p3_portfolio.png) and the DB write path is proven (p3_candidate_ok2.png).
Screenshots captured with flameshot (GNOME Wayland); grim is unsupported on this compositor.
